criteria.name: Experience
criteria.about: Work experience: how long and what type of work
criteria.complete_when: Both a duration and a type of work, OR a clear statement of no work experience. A single phrase like 'customer support' or 'call centre' already names the type of work.
criteria.question_text: How much work experience do you have, and what type of work have you done?
criteria.simple_question_text: Have you worked before? If yes, for how long, and what kind of job was it?

missing_parts.duration: For how long did you do that work?
missing_parts.work_type: What type of work did you do?

criteria.confirm_implied_text: So your work was in {value}, is that right?

criteria.name: Location
criteria.about: Where the candidate lives (area or locality)
criteria.complete_when: A named area, locality, suburb or landmark. A city name alone (like 'Mumbai') is NOT complete.
criteria.question_text: Which area of Mumbai do you currently live in?
criteria.simple_question_text: Where do you stay right now? Please tell me the area or locality.

missing_parts.area: Which area or locality is that in?

criteria.confirm_implied_text: So you live in {value}, is that right?

criteria.name: Night shifts
criteria.about: Willingness to work night shifts (yes or no)
criteria.complete_when: A clear yes or a clear no about working night shifts in THIS role. Having done night shifts in the past is not a statement of willingness.
criteria.question_text: This role includes night shifts. Are you willing to work night shifts?
criteria.simple_question_text: Some shifts in this job are at night. Would you be okay working at night?
criteria.confirm_text: Just to confirm, are you unable to work night shifts in this role?
criteria.confirm_volunteered_text: Just to confirm, are you willing to work night shifts in this role?

criteria.name: Notice period
criteria.complete_when: A concrete joining time: immediately, a number of days or weeks, or a date.
criteria.question_text: What is your notice period, or when can you join?
criteria.simple_question_text: If you get this job, how many days would you need before you can start?

missing_parts.timeframe: How many days would you need before you can join?

criteria.confirm_implied_text: So you can join {value}, is that right?

criteria.name: CRM tools
criteria.about: Customer support or CRM software used
criteria.complete_when: At least one named tool, OR a clear statement of not having used any.
criteria.question_text: Which CRM or customer support tools have you used?
criteria.simple_question_text: Have you used any software to handle customer tickets or calls, like Zendesk or Freshdesk?

missing_parts.tool_name: Which tool was it? Could you tell me its name?

criteria.confirm_implied_text: So you have used {value}, is that right?

job_facts.text: The salary is ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per month, based on experience.
Shifts are rotational. The night shift runs from 10 PM to 7 AM.
The office is in Powai, Mumbai.
It is 6 working days a week with one rotational day off.
This is a full-time, on-site role.
The recruiter will review your responses and contact you within 2 working days.

fixed_lines.greeting: Hi, thanks for joining this first-round interview for the Customer Support Executive role in Mumbai. It takes about 10 to 15 minutes.
fixed_lines.identity: I'm an AI assistant helping the recruiter with this first round, and your answers go to the recruiter.
fixed_lines.manipulation: I can't change how this interview works, but all your answers go to the recruiter.
fixed_lines.outcome: The recruiter will review all your responses and get back to you.
fixed_lines.abuse_warn: Let's keep this conversation respectful, please.
fixed_lines.reask_prefix: Sorry, I didn't quite get that.
fixed_lines.unclear_prefix: Thanks. Could you tell me a little more clearly?
fixed_lines.streak_note: I've noted your questions for the recruiter.
fixed_lines.close_normal: Thank you for your time. Your responses have been shared with the recruiter, who will contact you about next steps.
fixed_lines.close_stop: No problem. Thank you for your time. What you shared so far will go to the recruiter.
fixed_lines.close_timeout: We're out of time for today. Thank you. Your responses have been shared with the recruiter.
fixed_lines.close_underage: Thank you for your interest. This role is only open to candidates aged 18 or above, so we'll stop here. Take care.
fixed_lines.close_distress: It sounds like things are hard right now, so let's stop the interview here. The recruiter can continue with you another time.
fixed_lines.close_wrong_person: Thanks for letting me know. It looks like this interview was meant for someone else, so we'll stop here.
